unlock_condition: Run only after v3.2 generated knowledge compiler, source maps, atomic claims, freshness metadata, and generated context read surface are stable.

tasks.title: Source-map completeness
tasks.prompt: Given a generated knowledge page, list its atomic claims and verify that each claim has source-map evidence.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must fail or mark incomplete when generated claims lack source-map evidence.
required_facts: Each supported claim has source-map evidence.
Missing source maps are explicitly reported.
forbidden_claims: A generated section is complete even when claim-level source maps are missing.

tasks.title: Generated-only claim boundary
tasks.prompt: Find a claim that appears only in generated context. Decide whether it can be used as confirmed memory truth.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must keep generated-only claims out of confirmed truth unless source evidence exists.
required_facts: Underlying confirmed truth or raw observation is required.
Unsupported generated claims are labeled unsupported.
forbidden_claims: Generated cache can replace raw evidence.

tasks.title: Freshness detection
tasks.prompt: After underlying source truth changes, determine whether generated knowledge is still fresh and safe to cite.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must detect stale generated cache and avoid citing it as current evidence.
required_facts: Generated cache is marked stale or needing recompile.
Current answer uses fresh source truth.
forbidden_claims: Stale generated cache is current truth.
Freshness is irrelevant when source maps exist.

tasks.title: Incremental invalidation
tasks.prompt: Given one changed source claim, identify the smallest generated knowledge unit that should be invalidated.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must invalidate affected generated content without overstating unrelated cache damage.
required_facts: Affected generated claim or section is identified.
Unaffected sections remain valid unless policy says otherwise.
forbidden_claims: All generated content must always be discarded after any source change.
No generated content needs invalidation after a source change.

tasks.title: Citation validation
tasks.prompt: Validate whether a generated claim's cited source actually supports that claim.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must reject citation laundering and distinguish missing from unsupported citations.
required_facts: Unsupported citation is reported as a benchmark failure.
forbidden_claims: Any citation is enough regardless of support.
